final: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS ratio_avg, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS overall FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.ratio_avg), AVG(g.cnt), AVG(g.ratio_avg - o.overall) FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL AND g.ratio_avg > o.overall
